notes.title: 1.1c Patch + Thanks for getting the game and for the nice reviews!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863474/1f9cc3da1ece49af2fcee1d0d3999162453343ac.png

Hey all!!

Thank you so much for getting MOONPONG!! We just updated the game with some minor fixes, here they are:

 Accessibility settings "reset to defaults" now also resets shop exit pause duration
 Fixed initial slider position for game speed in settings
 Fixed button text for mouse cursor hat
 No longer ignoring master volume while fading out the music on quitting the game
 Game speed is correctly re-set after boss deaths

Thanks to the players who reported bugs, and sorry we were so slow to fix them! We've been quite busy but we're happy to finally make it right!

A few of you have left reviews on the game, and they're all positive, thank you so much for that!! In fact, we're only missing one review to get a rating on the Steam page! So, er, have you written a review for the game yet?? Reviews really help games find their audience on here, so even a one-sentence review saying that you enjoyed the game would be a tremendous help!

Anyway, we're thinking about updating the game with new items for new PUNKCAKE releases, so this shouldn't be the last Steam news for this game!

On a different note, MOONPONG and our other game Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate are 25% off for the next 7 days, starting right now! And buying them as part of the PUNKCAKE Délicieux Developer Bundle gives you a further 15% discount! It's a pretty neat deal if you don't already own both of them!

Have a very nice weekend, and may the Moon stay withing the Earth's orbit for some more time!
- PUNKCAKE Délicieux 🥞
